knowledge_boundary: Client static construction and consumption. Unknown server-required fields and responses remain unknown/open/raw.
canonical_registry: endpoint_registry.json (name/id frozen; params=query alias, body=body observations; path_params separate; include_in_sdk selects core+aux)

http_argument_mapping.jt: request params renamed query, headers renamed header; path keys destructured out for templates
http_argument_mapping.query_encoding: omit null/undefined; preserve0/false/empty string; array -> repeated key for nonnull elements, not implicit comma join; callers may explicitly join comma beforehand
http_argument_mapping.rest_body: App uni object data; SDK JSON unless FormData/Blob/ArrayBuffer/raw requested. Do not apply SSE wT cleanup to all REST calls.
http_argument_mapping.sse_body: wT deletes top-level null/undefined/empty-string only, then JSON.stringify; no recursive scrub

app_unwrap_precedence: object data property exists and data !== undefined/null -> data
else result property exists and result !== undefined -> result (null allowed)
else undefined; app does not fallback raw object in $0e
http_envelope.missing_or_non_numeric_code: accepted by ordinary app success check
http_envelope.http_401_or_numeric_business_401: ordinary xi rejects first (even returnEnvelope), app logs out unless skipLoginRedirect then reject without redirect
http_envelope.other_business_failure: on 2xx and !returnEnvelope: numeric code outside accepted set rejects; loginBizHandled wraps code/result/raw in LoginBizApiError; ordinary path may reject unwrapped payload rather than Error
http_envelope.returnEnvelope: on2xx returns raw server object before normal numeric business error validation; some job more callers need code400=no more
sdk_requirements: Expose requestRaw/returnEnvelope or allowBusinessCodes so caller can inspect unmodeled codes and no-more400.
No DOM toast/logout/redirect implicit SDK side effect.
Keep non-JSON errors/body text/raw response rather than assuming server schema.

auth_and_headers.ordinary_app: jSe sets timeout60s, withCredentials=true, appends validToken or raw tokenInfo accessToken/token unless an exact Authorization already truthy. Ip client X headers only same API origin/relative wapi.

profiles.RECOMMEND: tryGetValidToken only; no raw token fallback in resolveHeaders

sse.cookies: fetch credentials default include; plusXHR withCredentials true. Therefore resolveHeaders containing only Bearer does NOT prove Bearer-only transport. Android plugin cookie behavior not specified by JS options.
sse.trace: Only instrumentation context adds traceId; no mandatory command/task/run identifier.
sse.json_401: B5e only numeric code401 -> D5e; BXe initiates UI logout/navigate and returns false; guarded resend does not execute. Other non2xx HTTP failures are generic errors, not ordinary xi flow.

auth_and_headers.sdk_cross_origin: API auth headers must not automatically flow to separately configured external service/absolute URL. Explicit base/service credential policy; do not imitate app broad Bearer interceptor across origins.
auth_and_headers.nebula: requires explicit serviceBases.nebula; Authorization is raw signature response authorization plus query sig, not inferred API Bearer. No fixed ASR websocket path.

upload_contract.chat_file_upload: raw.result.file_id is required by app parsers sUe/YUe; result returned as fileInfo, name/extension may normalize; standard data-first unwrap does not apply
upload_contract.source_weakness_boundary: App upload parser checks result.file_id independent of HTTP/business code in the parser. SDK should still reject HTTP error status and preserve raw; do not copy weak validation as success guarantee.
upload_contract.encoding: FormData binary part file, additional body fields open for resume uploads; browser/fetch sets boundary automatically; source manually labels multipart but SDK must not force a fixed boundary.
upload_contract.binary_preview: use raw/Blob/ArrayBuffer. Content-Type can be PDF/image/other resource; not universal JSON.

sse_parser.wire_frames: split blank line /\r?\n\r?\n/; recognize id,event,data; trim field values; last data line overwrites previous; JSON.parse data else retain string
no_evidence_for: EOF without logical DONE equals delivery/task success

DOUZI.done_rule: Only fallback/final else checks Yk(event) || data === "[DONE]", after earlier named branches and active work-mode notice handler. A named known event such as delta carrying string [DONE] is consumed by its earlier branch and is NOT logical DONE.
DOUZI.body: main removes author; adds APP; source context/parent selection can overwrite caller parent. Caller-supplied raw payload remains open.

RECOMMEND.done_rule: Only final else checks Yk(event) || data === "[DONE]". Earlier named event branches take precedence, including named delta/[DONE] data.
RECOMMEND.body: author.role=user; current_condition from conditionSnapshot plus userId; quote selected_text/style/job_id. Does not run main B sanitizer; sendPayload spreads caller after defaults so caller can override.
RECOMMEND.auth: tryGetValidToken only; no raw token fallback in resolveHeaders

RESUME_OPTIMIZATION.done_rule: Normal m() completes only Yk(event) || (!event && data === "[DONE]"). Yk itself means no event and data marker. Named [DONE] event/data alone does not logically complete. resume_delta is routed away before m().
RESUME_OPTIMIZATION.body: requires local revisionId and text for ordinary send; init content_type=resume_polish_init. metadata resume_revision_id, style=resume_part_select, selected_path/name arrays, optional selected_text(path,path_name,text). Text send includes author.role=user; init does not.
RESUME_OPTIMIZATION.app_close_side_effect: App also finalizes on non-manual close and may voice-apply buffered edits; this is not logical DONE evidence and SDK must not silently persist/apply on EOF.

JOB_MATCH.done_rule: No dedicated [DONE] check in consumer. event score updates score, other data concatenated to explanation; nonmanual close settles UI. Do not reuse DO UZI logical-DONE success assumption.

sse_parser.sdk_design: Default userSay profile by conversionType; explicit donePredicate override available. Keep all raw events and do not auto applyMode/persist revision. For JOB_MATCH/raw streams EOF is transport termination, not a proven business terminal result.

main_text.content_type: fileInfo -> multimodal_text; quote only -> multi_part; else text

notes: Top-level parent/cid follow current active scope, not guaranteed source M/C.
sendUserPayload does not add ordinary text default system_hints or market enrichment.
SDK should construct and return raw request/events; no automatic proxy toggle, work-mode update, pending confirmation or delivery operation.

main_custom_mode_card.source_call: sendUserCustomContent(text part option.title, metadata{parent:card.id,style:exact wireId}, onSendStarted)
notes: Metadata parent is card ID; final top-level parent may be scope-derived.
wireId can preserve a nonempty server alias; do not silently canonicalize arbitrary raw wireId.
SDK does not auto-apply work mode or proxy settings.
Dedicated SSE URL override; no conversation_id, author or APP metadata added by main retry helper.
Origin user resolved by answer round_id in app UI; SDK should require explicit IDs rather than invent cross-namespace mapping.
Server request distinct from local AbortSignal. A local abort does not prove backend work stopped.

special_field_notes.note: only enabled true + truthy provided mode in p4e; disabled omits mode; backend semantics unknown
source removes update from body; input.update===false -> query update:false only; metadata must be nonempty object in client guard
metadata nonempty guard; optional nonempty changes array; unknown backend validation
POST with query id, not JSON id body
chat targetType MESSAGE; other target types dynamic. Source compiled APP feedback sends platform MINI_PROGRAM. Do not rewrite it to APP based on build assumptions.
find endpoint uses targetEnum, reasons/report endpoints use targetType; do not unify property names
wrapper default string20; observed histories often numeric30; preserve explicit caller override
wrapper defaults1/10; callers override pageSize30 in some views

result_delivery_bridge.execution_policy: Explicit call only. sendConfirmedResume is a real delivery write, never auto-called by SDK on SSE/task/card/pending results. No business call performed during analysis.
result_delivery_bridge.id_boundary: Observed confirmation sender messageId=Number(rawPendingItem.id), distinct from ordinary AI message.id namespace unless server independently proves a relation. listByJobIds POST is a read query.

connect_headers.Authorization: Bearer token if present, refreshed before each connection

protocol_services.websocket_factory: App uses UniSocketAdapter -> uni.connectSocket({url,header,protocols}). Browser standard WebSocket cannot set arbitrary upgrade headers; require custom adapter/factory if server needs them. STOMP-only Authorization is not proven equivalent.
do_not_invent: automatic agent start or mode application

protocol_services.authorization: actual returned URL/ticket fields; do not construct a fixed recognition path or copy App credentials automatically

unsupported_operations.boundary: All same-hash script endpoint literal inventory contains only conversation/{id} GET, conversation/messages GET, conversations GET. Exact remote path/operation-name negatives retained in evidence.json. Local clearConversationMessages/resetSession are not a remote API.
unsupported_operations.sdk_action: Do not generate unproven convenience endpoints; use explicit requestRaw when a separately verified server contract becomes available.

unsupported_operations.operation: dedicated quick-reply setter / suggestion mutation endpoint
unsupported_operations.boundary: quick_reply comes from SSE; user selections feed userSay content/value/metadata. Homepage suggestions use GET /wapi/partners/suggest/homepage/v2.
unsupported_operations.sdk_action: Expose raw SSE and userSay; do not invent /quickReply RPC.

source_only_wrappers: All registry capabilities preserved even zero statically resolved call sites; descriptive export alias candidates labelled; neither no caller nor a wrapper presence proves runtime use or backend availability.
